# Voiceover (placeholder)

`vo` is the only spoken line for the scene. About 2.5 words per second of `durationSec`.

`voiceId` must be one of the studio bank ids: `warm_kid_female`, `playful_young_male`, `confident_presenter_female`, `deep_storyteller_male`. This repo ships 4 presets, not a separate 11-voice list.

Use the cast member's `voiceId` when it is in that bank. A Hinglish line of about 25 words ran near 10 seconds in a live test, so do not exceed the 2.5 words/second target.
